content: Cisimo ca Muka Kukuva

Kaha naua Yesu uaputukile kulongesa ku cikuma ca cisali. Kaha na civunga ca vantu calikunguluile kuli ikeye, kaha uakovelele nakutumama mu vuato ha cisali, kaha civunga coshe cakele ku cikuma ca cisali ha ntunda.
Kaha uavalongesele viavingi mu visimo, kaha mu vilongesa viendi uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi,
“Ivuilileni! Muka kukuva uaile nakukuva.
Kaha omo uakunine, imo mbuto yauilile kumukulo ua ngila, kaha tuzila vezile nakuilia.
Imo mbuto yauililile ha mavue aje kuuakele na mavu amengi, kaha hajevene yasokele omuo kuhakele mavu amengi,
kaha omuo litangua lia tuhukile vije vimbuto via jujuamene, omuo mizi kuyakovelele cikuma mu mavu kaha yomine.
Ikuavo mbuto yauilile mu mingonga kaha mingonga yakolele nakuituva, kaha kuya hakele vinona.

Kaha vikuavo vimbuto viauililile mu mavu acili, kaha viahakele vinona viavingi, kaha viakolele nakulivuezelela kuima, vimo viemine makumi atatu, vikuavo viemine makumi atanu na limo, kaha vikuavo viemine cihita.”
Kaha Yesu uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Uoshe hali na matuitui ovue.”
Omuo vika Yesu ualikuasesele Visimo
Omo uakele lika liendi, kaha vaje vakele kuyehi nendi hamo na vandongisi vendi likumi na vavali vamuhuile via ha visimo.
Kaha uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Kuli yeni vaje vavanahana vushueke vua vumuene vua Njambi, vuno honi kuli vaje vali hambanza vioshe vili mu visimo,
nankuma linga,
Yesu Alumbununa Cisimo ca Muka Kukuva
Kaha Yesu uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Nkuma kumuesi nakuvuisisa eci cisimo ndi? Kaha nkuma vatihoni mukevivuisisa visimo vioshe?
Muka kukuva akakuvu lizi.
Ava vakevo vantu vanalifu ngue vimbuto vije viauilile kumukulo ua ngila, kuje lizi valikuva, kaha omo valivua, kaha hajevene Satana eja nakuambata lije lizi livanakuvu muli vakevo.
Kaha vamo vantu vanapu ngue vimbuto vije vivakuvile ha mavue, omo vevua lizi, kaha hajevene valitambula nanzolela,
kaha kuvesi na mizi muli vakevo, vuno honi kuvakasimbula nalio, kaha omo tuyando cipue mapakeso vikeja omuo ya lizi, kaha hajevene vakaua.
Kaha vamo vanapu ngue vimbuto vije vivakuvile mu mingonga, ava vakevo vaje vevua lizi,
vuno honi vakevo vaniunga via mavu na kuzanga vufuko, kaha nalishungu lia viuma vieka vikovela nakutuva lizi, kaha kulimi vushuka.
Vuno honi vije vivakuvile mu mavu acili, vanapu vaje vevua lizi nakulitambula na kuima vushuka, makumi atatu na makumi atanu na limo, na cihita.”
Ndeya ha Citumbiko cayo
Kaha Yesu uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Nkuma muntu akanehe ndeya nakuihaka muntsi lia liendeko, cipue muntsa muhela ndi? Nkuma kaihaka ha citumbiko cayo ndi?
Omuo nacimo cahi cuma cakushueka, cihonoua kuija hakutoka, kaha naua nacimo cahi ca vushueke civahonoua kuneha ku ceke.
Nga uoshe uje hali na matuitui evue.”
Kaha uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Niungeni vimuli na kuivua, seteko muhana ikeyo vakamihana neni naua, vuno honi yeni vakamivuezelelako.
Uoshe hali naviavingi vakamuvuezelelako, kaha uje kesi, cipue cije cali naco va kamutambulaco.”
Cisimo ca Mbuto ya Kumena
Kaha Yesu uahandekele nguendi, “Vumuene vua Njambi vunapu ngue muntu akuva mbuto mu mavu,
cipue vene akosa tulo omo ahinduka vije vimbuto vimena na kukola vutsiki na mutania, vuno honi katantekeya muvili nakukolelamo.
Cakulivanga mavu akahaka cishati, kaha mutue, kaha vinona ku mitue.
Vuno honi omo vimbuto vinahi, hajevene uavitejele na mpoko ya kutejesa omuo ntsimbu ya kuteja yahetele.”
Cisimo ca Mbuto ya Musalata
Kaha Yesu uahandekele nguendi, “Vumuene vua Njambi tukavusetekesa na vika, cipue cisimo muka tukalikuasesa hali vukevuo?
Vunapu ngue nona ya musalata, ije omo vaikuva mu mavu, kaha ikeyo yapua yaindende cikuma ku vimbuto vioshe via ha mavu.
Vuno honi omo vaikuva kaha ikakola na kupua yakama kupulakana viputa vioshe, kaha ikahaka mintango yakama, ngeci tuzila va muilu vapangelemo mashua mu cimbembe cayo.”
Omuo ya visimo viavingi evi, Yesu uahandekele lizi kuli vakevo kuya nomu muvahaselele kulivuisisa.
Kahandekele kuli vakevo kuakuhona cisimo, vuno honi kumukulo uakele nakulumbunuina vandongisi vendi viuma voshe.
Yesu Aholuesa Linkimba
Ha litangua lije, omo capuile cinguezi, Yesu uahandekele kuli vandongisi vendi nguendi, “Tuyeni musinia lia cisali.”
Kaha omo vasezele civunga vaile nakukovela nendi mu vuato. Kaha na mato eka akele nendi.
Kaha linkimba liakama lia mpunzi liezile, kaha na mankimba aputukile kukovela mu vuato, kaha na vuato vuaputukile kushula.
Vuno honi Yesu uakele kuntongo uakosele tulo oku najendamena ha musato, kaha vamuhinduile nakuhandeka kuli ikeye nguavo, “Mulongisi, kuuazivukile nguove tutsa ndi?”
Kaha uahindukile nakutenukila mpunzi, kaha uahandekele ku mankimba nguendi, “Ciyulo! Holoka!” Kaha mpunzi yaholokele, kaha kuakele kuholoka cakama kuluu.
Kaha uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Vika muteua? Kumuesi na lutsilielo ndi?”
Kaha vakele na liova, kaha vahandekele kuli umo na mukuavo nguavo, “Iya honi ou, cipue mpunzi na mankimba vimuivuila?”
